name: 1.23.0-beta.13
notes: Sounds on pages: music and sound effects can be added to pictures, to listen to while reading. A page's sounds loop for as long as you are on it; if the next page has the same sound it keeps playing without a break, and a different one fades in as the old one fades out. A page can have several sounds.

Add them from the reader (the note button at the top: add sound files, or one the gallery already has; listen; volume and mute) or to many pages at once in Edit (select the pages, then Sound). Pages with sound show a note mark. Sounds are kept encrypted with the gallery, and go with it in backups and sync.
Ren'Py games: Pictures on screen also lists the music and sounds playing now; switched on, they go with the picture(s) you make or add, and play when you look at them in the gallery.
